# Synthetic audit fixture: 12-digit AWS account ID in the JSON form an STS
# GetCallerIdentity response dump prints - a quoted Account key whose id
# suffix is absent, colon separator, quoted value - with no ARN on the
# line, so the account label context detector is what must fire. The label
# detector matches a lowercased copy of the line, so the key's case and the
# missing suffix are both covered by the one pattern, and the value anchor
# keeps a bare quoted Account key with a non-numeric value silent.
# Synthetic value.
"Account": "123456789012"
